content.text:
The drawing shows a furan ring with an oxygen at the bottom. A nitro group (O2N) is attached at the left carbon (C5), and an aldehyde group (CHO) is attached at the right carbon (C2). The molecule is 5-nitrofuran-2-carbaldehyde (5-nitrofurfural).

The aldehyde is drawn with a C=O to the upper right, and the ring contains two double bonds, each between a substituted carbon and its neighbouring CH.

Written as SMILES, the nitro group is [N+](=O)[O-], and the aldehyde carbon is O=Cc1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])o1.

SMILES: O=Cc1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])o1
